# BuildFlow Business Entity Resolution

Capability ID: buildflow-entity-resolution-machine-v1
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: human_auth_handoff
Public URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/capabilities/buildflow-entity-resolution-machine-v1/index.html
Preferred agent route: universal fallback
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/mcp
Start here: Not a current sell-now route

## Use this when

- dedupe our vendor list safely
- the same customer exists in multiple systems
- match vendors without silently merging them
- resolve duplicate suppliers across ERP exports
- AI found uncertain business entity matches
- reconcile customer or vendor identity conflicts

## Problem

A business has duplicate or conflicting customer/vendor identities across systems and needs evidence-preserving matching with human adjudication rather than silent merges.

## Inputs

Authenticated source records and mapping candidates.

## Outputs

MappingCandidate confidence, conflict flags, MappingDecision lineage and review work items.

## Pricing

No approved machine price/payment path was found. Do not auto-quote.

## Invocation and authority

SOURCE-VERIFIED: discovery and authenticated Decision Desk adjudication are implemented and build-tested; external client canary remains pending. Canonical merge remains a separate gated action.

Accepting a mapping records an adjudication; it does not silently rewrite source evidence or auto-merge canonical counterparties.

Payment authority: No verified Evercraft Payments path.

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
